cases.evidence: User confirmed both clients signed in; server observed two owned devices and two bound client sessions.

User initially saw no devices. After opening Accessible devices, clearing search, and explicit refresh, user confirmed both devices visible. HTTPS groups/users/peers all returned 200 and peers total 2.
User confirmed Mac-created personal-book entry and alias were visible on Windows after refresh and logout/relogin.
User confirmed Mac connection succeeded after signing back into the test account; prior authenticated secure_tcp timeout no longer blocks the tested connection.

cases.prior_blocker: Authenticated remote connection fails before target authentication: Failed to secure tcp: deadline has elapsed. User confirmed logout from Mac restores connection with identical API/ID/Relay/Key configuration.
cases.evidence: After fixed PR #734 deployment, user followed the paired Mac/Windows acceptance steps and confirmed Mac remote connection succeeded and Windows connected to the same third target without re-entering its password.

diagnosis.initial_empty_view_root_cause: not isolated: page selection, filters and explicit refresh were changed together
diagnosis.native_ui_automation: application accessibility read timed out; acceptance uses user report, not agent GUI claim
diagnosis.authenticated_remote_connection: Client 1.5.0 with a nonempty access_token and configured server key initiates secure_tcp before PunchHoleRequest; OSS 1.1.16 waits for the client first frame. Source-confirmed protocol incompatibility; user logout control restores remote connection.

remediation.verified_by: user-operated official clients, RustDesk 1.5.0 on reported macOS 27 and Windows 11
